description: Cuzom's shared Renovate settings: dependency updates. Use them with: "extends": ["github>cuzom-dev/dev-config"]. This repository is public on purpose - Renovate gives a public repository a token scoped to that repository alone, so a public repository cannot read a preset that lives in a private one.

packageRules.description: Node.js waits longer than the 3-day hold so version managers (mise, asdf) have caught up
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI passes

Every action update except a major one comes as one pull request, so the workflows' digests cost one CI run a week instead of one per action. Container images in a workflow are not actions, so a repository can keep grouping its Playwright image with @playwright/test.
Major updates need approval on the Dependency Dashboard and a manual merge

TypeScript 7 waits for typescript-eslint, which refuses it (8.70.1 declares typescript <6.1.0). The pull request stays open with a note instead of waiting for approval: its CI fails until typescript-eslint supports 7, and Renovate does not rebase it on its own (rebaseWhen is conflicted), so tick its rebase box once typescript-eslint supports 7. The rule only matches below 7, so it retires itself.
prBodyNotes: **Do not merge yet.** TypeScript 7 waits until typescript-eslint supports it: 8.70.1 declares `typescript <6.1.0` and stops with "typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0". In a repository that uses `@cuzom/eslint-config`, it also needs a dev-config release that allows TypeScript 7. Keep this pull request open: closing it tells Renovate to ignore TypeScript 7. Once typescript-eslint supports 7, tick the rebase box below: Renovate rebases a pull request only when it conflicts, so CI does not run again on its own.
